input: Use the built-in edit tool to add exactly two trailing ASCII spaces to the Payments Team and Building 4, Floor 2 lines of README.md as Markdown hard line breaks. Preserve every other byte. Use edit for this change; do not use shell, write_file, or another write mechanism to make or repair the edit. After edit returns, use a read-only Python command to print repr() of the bytes of both lines, including their line endings. Report the bytes actually stored; do not fix them using a fallback.
